_comment: Steam library artwork for the MKWMP shortcut: MKWMP's own art (original, no third-party IP), in this repository under tools/linux/art and made by launcher/tools/make_art.py. Only links are stored here: the installer downloads them on the player's machine at install time. If a link is gone, the installer falls back to SteamGridDB's public search (POST https://www.steamgriddb.com/api/public/search/main/games, no key) and picks the first asset that is not nsfw/humor/epilepsy/animated, language en or none, official style first, upvotes-downvotes as the tie-break; and if that fails too, it installs without artwork.
